meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周拆成文件;每周用一个子代理依次写一章叙述摘要,后一章接收前一章的交接信息,最终产出多章 digest、索引和完成报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”等,想按周分章看项目历史时触发;需 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目至少有一周数据。

say.text: 把 [项目名] 按周做成叙述章节
say.note: 会先拆分时间线,再逐周写章。

say.text: 用 week-by-week 形式讲讲这个项目的历史
say.note: 触发串行子代理,每周一章。

say.text: 从第一周到最后一周,按周讲述项目的故事
say.note: 最终输出按周排序的 digest 文件。

howto.what_en: Splits the project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week (each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block) to produce one narrative chapter per week, plus an index and a completion report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', etc. Requires a running claude-mem worker and at least one ISO week of project data.

say_en.note: It splits the timeline and writes each week's chapter.

say_en.text: Tell the story of this project week by week
say_en.note: Runs the serial subagent pipeline, one chapter per week.

say_en.text: From the first week to the last, recount the project per week
say_en.note: Outputs zero-padded digest files in order.
